# Pull request

## Story

Story ID and title:

Related issue, if one exists:

## Result

Describe the observable result and why it is needed.

## Scope and decisions

List acceptance criteria covered, prerequisite stories and decisions resolved. State any scope changes or remaining limitations.

## Validation

List relevant tests/checks and their results. Include device or deployment evidence where the story requires it. For documentation-only changes, report the applicable documentation checks.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Prerequisite stories are merged into `main`.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria and relevant CI checks pass.
- [ ] Module boundaries and data ownership are respected.
- [ ] New application-owned text supports French and English where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and code use English; no credentials are committed.
- [ ] Changed contracts, setup steps and decisions are documented.
